svg.title: Bays & manoeuvring · Layout · 8 bays
svg.desc: Eight 2.5 by 5 metre parking bays face across the full 7 metre two-way aisle. The module is 17 metres overall. One space receives half the shared aisle for area accounting. Source claims: parking-layout, parking-area. Dated repeating interior-bay example; row ends are excluded. End-bay widening, doors, transfers and manoeuvres are not validated by the scale cars. Car body plan 5 × 1.8 m, assumed height/detail; person 1.75 m and tree 5 m. Context pads and ground thickness are illustration assumptions outside the measured module. Highlight relief is a graphic overlay, not a construction layer.
